purpose: Determine whether the already saved DEVELOPMENT optimization trajectories contain checkpoints satisfying the existing SOXX tail gates and nonnegative original training utility, before changing the optimizer. Diagnostic only: no new selected strategy or alternative out-of-sample path.

registration_boundary.known_before_registration: The selected incumbents and their original stored training utilities are already known; the selected-path audit found training tail violations.
registration_boundary.new_analysis_not_yet_run: Joint MaxDD/CVaR feasibility of every saved intermediate DEVELOPMENT checkpoint.

inventory.deduplication: Never collapse checkpoints/seeds because their values match. Shared benchmark arrays may be cached only by identical date/return hash and cost.
inventory.missing_or_duplicate_record_policy: Stop with exact missing/duplicate identities; no fill, interpolation, skip, refit or regenerated epoch.

data_contract.source_mode: Qlib Recorder objects only; original strict-prior DatasetH fold rows and already standardized/masked features
data_contract.maturity: Original annual Jan1 America/New_York cutoff; feature and one-day return availability strictly before cutoff; do not add H5 purge or alter original rows.
required_identity_checks: source artifact bytes hash before R.load_object
training feature and return byte hashes against every run metadata
checkpoint tensor SHA256 and epoch uniqueness
every actual return finite and greater than -1
source code hashes required for inference/accounting/utility/analysis match parent R manifest
data_contract.forbidden_scope: No diagnostic-year models, no post2022 portfolio returns, no model fitting or optimizer updates, no raw-provider refresh, no source or hyperparameter changes.

recompute.start_state: CASH, NAV1 for policy and same-cost SOXX reference
recompute.holdings: One complete continuous original training history; actual own marked holdings; all entry/later fees; no warmup scoring mask or terminal liquidation
recompute.policy: Deserialize each saved tensor snapshot and run the unchanged parent forward/settlement code; do not call fit_policy.
recompute.utility: Original J=min_c(U_c-U0_c); U_c=63/N sum_t log(g_policy/g_SOXX) - sqrt(mean_b(max(-sum_group_b log(g_policy/g_SOXX),0)^2)+1e-12).
recompute.risk_groups: Unchanged full63 groups at starts0,63,... plus final full group ending at cutoff when needed; retain original overlap.
recompute.utility_reference: Original exact-null kernel convention for reproducing stored U/J; independently constructed benchmark_path must reconcile to that reference.
recompute.analysis: Existing paired_metrics invokes Qlib risk_analysis N252 modeproduct, with initial-NAV anchored MaxDD and exact existing lower5% tail-mass CVaR.
recompute.mismatch_policy: Any J or per-cost centered-utility discrepancy outside the fixed tolerance stops acceptance and is retained as an integrity failure; never change tolerance after outcomes. Record signs and raw differences even within tolerance.

feasibility.risk_feasible: All four original tail gates, independent of J.
feasibility.J_tolerance_not_a_gate: No negative-J tolerance rescue. Retain raw J, stored J and sign-disagreement flags. Strictly positive numerical values are not themselves economically material or statistical evidence.
feasibility.null_counts: Verify null risk feasibility/J separately; never include the guaranteed null in the 7623 trajectory checkpoint counts.
feasibility.risk_and_positive_J_margin: risk_feasible AND recomputed centeredJ>1e-8; numerical-margin diagnostic only, not aggregate net-log-excess or qualification

per_run: best raw J among risk-feasible saved epochs
best raw J among risk-and-J>=0 saved epochs
corresponding raw risk gaps and utility parity errors
both-cost aggregate net-log-excess separately from utility
null-inclusive best risk-feasible J with null winning utility ties
diagnostic_summaries.tie_rule: Highest raw recomputedJ, null wins an exacttie, then earliestepoch. Diagnostic identifiers only; never selectedmodelbundles.
diagnostic_summaries.aggregate: Report by variant/year/seed with all denominators and worst gaps; matching/overlapping trajectories are not independent observations.

research_accounting.reason: Pure strict-prior training feasibility audit; no new policy OOS evaluation, no return-hypothesis comparison or deployment selection.
research_accounting.future_use_boundary: Any subsequent feasibility-aware incumbent policy or optimizer change must be separately preregistered and evaluated; this audit cannot relabel an old checkpoint as a qualified strategy.

workflow.cache_identity: Parent recorder, exact source artifact/code/plan hashes, fold date/feature/return/scaler hashes, checkpoint tensor hash, cost and diagnostic plan hash. No unregistered/latest fallback.
workflow.restart: No checkpoint replay cache or resume is implemented; each invocation recomputes all63runs. Parent recorded states are immutable inputs, never new model fits.

artifact_policy.full_checkpoint_paths: Compute and reduce one checkpoint/run chunk at a time; do not duplicate all daily paths in card root or memory. For an integrity mismatch retain the offending full path in the new Recorder for diagnosis; all normal paths remain reproducible from immutable parent snapshots and index.
artifact_policy.input_dependency: Exact parent manifest references identify committed frozen fold/snapshot objects; those parent bytes are not duplicated into this diagnostic.

before_market_checkpoint_evaluation: risk-gate boundary comparisons at fixed1e-10percentagepoint tolerance
J<0/J=0/J>0 count separation and null exclusion
duplicate/missing/tampered epoch or input hash rejection
all saved epochs used; deterministic best/first labels without model selection
no optimizer/OOS code path reachable from runner
post_execution: all7623 checkpoint models and126 null cost records accounted for
all original U/J parity checks pass

registration_clarifications.scope: No replay cache/resume or duplicatedparentfoldbytes; all financial/count/feasibility rules unchanged.
